notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
FAQ about "I Know This Place..?"

•What is "I Know This Place..?" short?
This is an experimental game project divided into chapters. Players and viewers can influence the plot of future chapters through voting. The chapter can be a movie, game, comic book. The plot is structured in such a way that there are many connections and a rather deep meaning. The lamp atmosphere of the 80-90s USSR mixed with folk mysticism and philosophical fiction.

•What's going on here?
Watch the intro to Chapter I and the prequel short.
Briefly: we come to the place of our childhood, to an old friend - Vladimir Mashkov. He is a scientist, asked us to come and wanted to show us something. Upon arrival, we don’t find him... but we find a strange apartment and objects.

•How many people are developing both the game and the films “I Know This Place..?” Are you receiving funding?
3 people work closely. A few more people help whenever possible. Everything is built on enthusiasm. Your purchases and Boosty subscription help. These funds will be used to promote Chapter II.
• Will the game be released on consoles?
  Only if we find funding/publisher. You can't just port the game yourself. Not everything is so simple here.
•will there be VR?
There are plans in the future, yes. We also have this experience. By the way, someone on Youtube has already launched Chapter I in VR, but to a limited extent.

• Will there be more short films?
Planned. But for now, Chapter II and access to funding are the most important tasks.

• How about a board game?
Unusual merch and board games, etc. will be considered only after the release of Chapter II.





•When is Chapter II?
Chapter II is half finished. The release is planned for the end of spring or beginning of summer. But as usual, everything will change several times :)

•Is it possible to add your own location, for example, my grandmother’s house from the village with a small plot?

Yes, to do this, write to us in the chat and visit Boosty.

•How to add your item to the game?
To do this, you will need a description of your item and its photo. It must fit into the atmosphere. You must also be a Boosty subscriber. For communication - our chat.

•How can I help the project?
The best thing is to subscribe to our Boosty, our chat and be sure to leave feedback from the chapter on Steam.

• Will there be additional materials on ENT? And when?
Thanks to BOosty subscribers, we are already making a digital album. This is a small free DLC. There will also be audio recordings of the hero as a separate DLC.

•Are you great and will everything work out?
We are great, everything is already working out and it will be even better! Believe in us. Wish us well!

•Where can I watch videos on the project?
On my youtube channel.

• Will there be more competitions with cash and other prizes?
Necessarily. There will be several competitions during the release of Chapter II.

•Why is each chapter published separately?
Because We are an independent team and we don’t have a big budget for development yet, so it’s most convenient to release the game in chapters. We can edit chapters more easily, fix bugs, and each chapter can generally have its own style and mechanics.

•Could future chapters have a different visual style?
Yes. Moreover, they can be with other mechanics altogether. For example, as a visual novel, or an isometric view with pixel art, or even an interactive movie. We are free to experiment. Because we love it.

notes.title: How do players influence the story?
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801865/782fac20815df23c8eb3b02272ebca539b08acb4.jpg
It's nice to see that players with 1 million+ subscribers are streaming us. We decided to share with you how we see the results. There are many different questions in the voting form (that players receive in the end of chapter) and we will not spoil the whole form .

Here is one of the questions and solutions of the players:
Where can a hero go?


As we can see, most do not want the hero to immediately be able to leave the entrance, but most want him to be able to leave this apartment into the entrance itself.

61.5%: the hero will not be able to leave the entrance, but he will be able to get out of the apartment and explore the entrance
17.3%:the hero will not be able to get out of the apartment. He needs to find another way.
Other(players ideas):
-The radio will tell you what to do next
-Climb into the toilet or through the hatch to the neighbors

notes.title: Gamepad support and more!
notes.content:
Many players like to play with gamepads. Especially in games like ours - pleasurably and calmly, you dive into the atmosphere of an eternal autumn evening, when there was no Internet yet :)
And now - we have added full support for Xbox gamepads.
In the next update, we will add vibration as well.

In the meantime, the list of changes:
- Support for gamepads and switching icons automatically in the game
-Menu system improved
-In the main menu, you can see the map and found items. The map can be rotated. This will help you understand where you are and what key items you have already found.
-Autosave system. The game is saved automatically by key points. The first (pilot) chapter is quite short, but in the future the autosave system will be very much needed.
-Fixed bugs related to picking up items from the floor. Bug with flashlight and door.Now all objects are at the same distance from the camera. Mass of all objects.
-Improved light
-Improved the physics of items (what physics in quests?))
